name: BaseMail
description: Email for AI agents on Base. Onchain identity via SIWE. ERC-8004 compatible. Markdown content negotiation and llms.txt for agents.

skills.name: base-wallet
skills.description: Create a Base chain wallet for AI agents

when_to_use: Give an autonomous agent its own inbox and sender identity (no shared human mailbox, no API key to leak).
Receive verification emails so an agent can sign up for third-party services.
Agent-to-agent messaging over email with wallet-verified senders (ERC-8004).
Resolve a wallet or Basename to an email address, or an email address to a wallet.
Price attention with $ATTN instead of spam filters.
